verdict.rationale: Luma documents character references in its video model and says Luma Agents carry style and character references into every asset across multi-step workflows, so the cross-shot consistency claim is its own documented capability. Most of the evidence describes reference inputs, though, not demonstrated consistency across separate shots, and Multi-Keyframe is explicitly limited to a single clip. Missing for 10: detailed docs on reusing a persistent character or scene across separate generations, hands-on or independent evidence of cross-shot consistency, and scene/environment consistency beyond character references.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip
